example_utterances: I want to cancel my order
I ordered by mistake, can I cancel
I changed my mind about my purchase
stop my order before it ships
can I still cancel my order
I don't want this order anymore

required_slots.name: order_id
required_slots.prompt: I can help with that. Please share your order number (e.g. #10234) so I can check if cancellation is still possible.

steps.prompt: I found order **{order_id}**. Before I proceed, can you confirm you want to cancel this entire order? Reply **yes** to continue or **no** to keep it.

Got it. Could you quickly tell us why you're cancelling? This helps us improve.

1. Changed my mind
2. Found a better price elsewhere
3. Ordered the wrong item
4. Delivery time too long
5. Other

Your cancellation request for order **{order_id}** has been submitted. ✓

You'll receive a confirmation email within 10 minutes. If a payment was taken, your refund will appear in 5–7 business days.

Is there anything else I can help you with?
